free_tier.stated: 1 GB disk each for PostgreSQL, MySQL and Valkey (Valkey maxmemory = 50% of 1 GB RAM = 512 MB usable); 20 GB storage for OpenSearch; Kafka free tier is throughput-capped at 250 KiB/s. 'Only one service of each service type in your organization.' No time limit, no credit card.

egress.terms: Free. 'Network traffic is not charged separately' (Aiven service pricing doc). This is the best egress term of any structured store here, which makes the tiny byte quotas the only blocker.

tooling: psql / mysql / redis-cli / OpenSearch REST API / any Kafka client; Aiven Terraform provider and `avn` CLI for provisioning; PG-wire and RESP protocols unchanged
chaining: One service of each type per ORG (verified in the Valkey free-tier doc: 'Only one service of each service type in your organization'). So one org yields ~1 + 1 + 0.5 + 20 GB = ~22.5 GB across four services, plus Kafka. 23 orgs would reach 500 GB. The best per-org yield of any structured store found, and the only one where egress is genuinely free.
limits_note: 1 GB disk (PG/MySQL), 1 GB RAM (Valkey, 50% maxmemory), 20 GB + 4 GB RAM + 2 shards (OpenSearch free), Kafka 250 KiB/s ingress/egress with 5 topics x 2 partitions and fixed retention; single node; no VPC; no static IPs; no forking; `max_connections` 20 on free PG
